title: 2021 Free Expression Awards Highlight: Susan Wojcicki
summary: Highlight clip from the 2021 Free Expression Awards honoring YouTube CEO Susan Wojcicki. The video became notable for its overwhelmingly negative like/dislike ratio.
why: Cited as an ironic example of YouTube receiving a free expression award, and as a showcase of the public dislike count before it was hidden.

quote.text: YouTube has been awarded a Free Expression Award from an organization sponsored by... YouTube.
